decisions.decision: Start now and build everything without waiting. (1) Clone Usetantra/tantra-backend-v2 (branch development) and Usetantra/tantra-mcp to ~/Documents/GitHub. Run them locally and record the current test, CI and preview state. (2) Take 3 to 5 recent Tantra feature requests or bugs from GitHub issues, PRs and session notes. Run each one through the agentic flow on its own branch with local tests and a local preview. Timestamp request, PR, merged and live. Open the PRs against development for Bharath to review. Do not merge to production. (3) Write the one-page pitch for Bharath: the retention argument, the pilot numbers you measured, and the Opus Clip 24h claim only if you can source it publicly (otherwise leave it out). (4) Write the review steps with time limits: product 2h, code 4h, QA 4h. (5) Add 24h ship rate, PR-to-live time and regression rate to T-158's spec. (6) Post the pitch and review steps on this task, set reviewer to Bharath, and move it to review.
decisions.why: Assignee is Claude; owner rules orchestrator-autonomy and build-fully-a[redacted] say build it end to end. Bharath is the CTO and on the team, so the board review covers 'sent' and 'agreed'. Memory usetantra-actions-free-plan: Usetantra has a capped Actions allowance, so CI runs locally and no new scheduled workflows go in.

decisions.decision: Do not wait on Bharath for the parts you can build. (1) In tantra-backend-v2, open one PR against development that fixes (or quarantines with a stated reason) the two red suites: distribution-processor.scheduling.spec.ts and clerk.webhook.controller.spec.ts. (2) Open a second PR adding a pre-merge script (npx jest + npm run build, run locally, no Actions workflow) and a per-branch docker compose preview script that prints the preview URL; post that URL on PRs #160 to #164. (3) In workshop-plan/pipeline/dash.py, pull opened/merged timestamps for the pilot PRs via the GitHub API so 24h ship rate, PR to live and regression rate fill in automatically once Bharath merges; show 'not merged yet' until then and flag PRs past the 2h/4h/4h limits as overdue. (4) Record minute-level request times for new intake. (5) Update agentic-dev-cycle.md and the T-154 evidence, then leave the task in review with Bharath. Do not merge anything yourself.
decisions.why: agentic-dev-cycle.md lists CI script, preview and the two red suites as 'not built yet', and the T-154 spec names them as basics. T-158 only has the metric definitions (log 2026-10-09T19:57). Rules orchestrator-autonomy and build-fully-a[redacted]: build first, then review.
